svg.title: Checks actually reached, and exactly where an operation stopped
svg.desc: One row per executed operation. Checkmark means policy block passed, cross means stopped with a reason, and hatching means not evaluated. Canary statements are authored booleans; no canary test ran. Full before and after registry hashes are in results.json.
svg.text: Recorded operations · ✓ passed policy block · × stopped here · hatched = not evaluated
Canaries are authored boolean claims. These are policy checks, not executed model safety tests.
